## Summary
Implement time-windowed Row Level Security policies so students can only read assessment_items that belong to their active (non-expired, non-completed) exam session.

## User story
As an exam security administrator, I want students to only see assessment item content during their active exam window, so that items cannot be harvested or previewed outside of exam time.

## Why this matters
C02 finding: without time-windowed RLS, a student could query assessment_items directly via the Supabase client and harvest all exam content before, after, or between exams. This is a critical security violation for LCME-accredited high-stakes assessments. AP-15 explicitly bans student item access outside an active session.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] RLS policy on assessment_items allows SELECT only when student has an active session containing that item
- [ ] "Active session" = started_at <= now() AND completed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now()
- [ ] B-tree index on exam_sessions(student_id, completed_at) ensures policy is performant
- [ ] Student with no active session gets 0 rows from assessment_items (not an error, just empty)
- [ ] Student with expired session gets 0 rows (time window closed)
- [ ] Student with completed session gets 0 rows (already submitted)
- [ ] Faculty/admin roles bypass the time-window restriction (can always read items)
- [ ] Policy does not affect INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations (those use separate policies)
- [ ] Performance: RLS check adds < 5ms per query on a 1000-item exam

| AP-15 | Student item access outside session is BANNED — RLS enforces this |
| Data Layer | RLS is the security floor — app-level filters are extra, never sufficient |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- packages/db/migrations/0002_time_windowed_rls.sql

-- B-tree index for RLS policy performance
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_exam_sessions_student_active
  ON public.exam_sessions (student_id, completed_at)
  WHERE completed_at IS NULL;

-- B-tree index for session_items lookup
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_session_items_session_id
  ON public.session_items (session_id);

-- Time-windowed RLS policy on assessment_items for students
-- Students can only read items that belong to their active, non-expired session
CREATE POLICY "Students see items only during active session"
  ON public.assessment_items FOR SELECT
  USING (
    -- Faculty/admin bypass
    (SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) IN ('admin', 'faculty')
    OR
    -- Student: must have active session containing this item
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.exam_sessions es
      JOIN public.session_items si ON si.session_id = es.id
      WHERE es.student_id = auth.uid()
        AND es.completed_at IS NULL
        AND es.expires_at > now()
        AND es.started_at <= now()
        AND si.assessment_item_id = assessment_items.id
    )
  );

-- Ensure no other SELECT policy is more permissive for students
-- Drop any existing overly-permissive policy if present:
-- DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "allow_all_select" ON public.assessment_items;
```

## Code patterns to follow
```sql
-- The RLS policy pattern: time-windowed access
-- Key: the EXISTS subquery with index support
CREATE POLICY "time_windowed_access"
  ON public.target_table FOR SELECT
  USING (
    -- Admin/faculty bypass (check role first — fast path)
    (SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) IN ('admin', 'faculty')
    OR
    -- Student: active session check (uses B-tree index)
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.exam_sessions es
      JOIN public.session_items si ON si.session_id = es.id
      WHERE es.student_id = auth.uid()
        AND es.completed_at IS NULL        -- not submitted
        AND es.expires_at > now()          -- not expired
        AND es.started_at <= now()         -- has started
        AND si.assessment_item_id = target_table.id
    )
  );
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```sql
-- ✗ AP-15: Permissive policy that allows students to see all items
CREATE POLICY "Students can read items"
  ON public.assessment_items FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL); -- BANNED — no session check

-- ✗ App-level filter without RLS (trusting the application, not the database)
-- In API route:
const items = await supabase
  .from('assessment_items')
  .select('*')
  .in('id', sessionItemIds); -- App filter is NOT sufficient — RLS is the floor

-- ✗ Missing index — RLS check does sequential scan
-- No CREATE INDEX on exam_sessions(student_id, completed_at) — BANNED
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E07/E07-S07.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Student with active session can read their session items', async ({ request }) => {
  // Authenticate as student with active session
  const res = await request.get('/api/exams/test-session/items');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.items.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('Student without active session gets 0 items', async ({ request }) => {
  // Authenticate as student with NO active session
  const res = await request.get('/api/assessment-items');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.items).toHaveLength(0);
});

test('Student with expired session gets 0 items', async ({ request }) => {
  // Authenticate as student whose session.expires_at < now()
  const res = await request.get('/api/assessment-items');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.items).toHaveLength(0);
});

test('Faculty can read all items regardless of session', async ({ request }) => {
  // Authenticate as faculty
  const res = await request.get('/api/assessment-items');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.items.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('Negative: student cannot access items from another students session', async ({ request }) => {
  // Authenticate as student A, try to read items from student B's session
  const res = await request.get('/api/assessment-items?session_id=other-student-session');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.items).toHaveLength(0); // RLS blocks cross-student access
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Students see items only during active session" ON public.assessment_items;`
2. `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_exam_sessions_student_active;`
3. `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_session_items_session_id;`
4. No Neo4j changes to revert.
5. `git stash && git checkout develop`
